cpu_matching.scope: Candidate setup, encoding, collection, optimization and finalization; persistence/shared preparation/whole worker costs are separate and not added twice.

protocol.artifact_storage_rule: All raw observations/models/attempts/update records retained. Duplicate final-policy diagnostic tables may be reconstructed from frozen raw inputs with original byte SHA256 checks; complete quality summaries remain verbatim.
protocol.cpu_control: Synchronous process-CPU checks at fixed-size optimizer, per-row encoding and per-decision runtime boundaries; no ITIMER_PROF. Native calls remain non-preemptible and actual overshoots fail the unchanged per-arm gate.

fit_plan_decision.reason: Prospective cap was32 before DEV. Confirmation retains the declared precision shortfall and every fit; no additional-episode substitution for independent fits.

protocol.freeze_rule: Publish source/protocol before fitting. Require every registered fit/arm to satisfy actual CPU and training validity, then publish/read back every formal model/decoder and receipt before generating independent confirmation worlds.
limits: Inherits finite interval law with at most one fresh event per interval, not CTMC task integration or Brownian limit.
Physical dynamics held fixed to focus on readout and feedback, not joint physical training.
Sign pooling only erases explicit refractory readout channel; signed reset/public observation can still preserve sign information.

Quality and CPU matching are distinct gates. Full worker CPU includes shared preparation and diagnostics; matched candidate budget includes setup/encoding/collection/optimization/export but not shared cohort generation or persistence.
Final-state exact coverage is relative to the declared numerical information representation, not universal reachable-support proof.
Readout recovery uses independently trained ridge decoders on paired populations, not information-theoretic irreversibility.
protocol.rng_namespace_contract: Registered fits below10000, worlds below10000. Execution role bases separated by2e12, per-fit stride100000, per-split stride10000; TRAIN probe differs from IID/OOD probe. Candidate pairing within a fit intentionally shares its role stream. Development_001, development_002 and the aborted formal training_001 retain their actual and planned-only role identities. Formal v2 uses new6003..6065 fits and no old confirmation observations.
protocol.selection_rule: All declared candidates retained. Final complete optimizer update, never best validation checkpoint. Development choices are frozen before new formal fits.

statistics.failure_rule: all attempted fits retained; any missing or invalid required arm blocks its contrast, no complete-case deletion
statistics.method: paired Student t, Bonferroni4 two-sided intervals; independent approximately normal fit differences assumption

protocol.training_objective: Fixed per-fit physical dynamics; train shared hidden head, belief and continuation Q with BCE/MSE/ranking. Fixed behavior conditional mass and detached realized visit supervision. No policy-gradient claim.
